exception.justification: Justified: Task-end publication inherits the connecting session's owned task lifetime; a separate drop span would report teardown outside its owner.

review.body: { let cause = self . cause . or_else (| | * self . refusal . lock () . unwrap_or_else (std :: sync :: PoisonError :: into_inner)) ; self . sender . send_if_modified (| state | { if * state == EndState :: Live { * state = EndState :: Ended (cause) ; true } else { false } }) ; }
review.item_premise: The task guard publishes only the first closed public cause from its own result or the shared relay refusal slot. Its Drop runs on task completion or cancellation and reads no private driver content.
